fruit.onepiece.gomu_gomu.desc: Turns the body into rubber. Immune to lightning, resists blunt force, stretches to fight.
tooltip.onepiece.curse: The sea will reject you forever.
stat.onepiece.durability.desc: +0.5 max health per point and up to 35% damage reduction.
stat.onepiece.agility.desc: +0.4% movement speed per point, longer dashes, shorter dash cooldown.
stat.onepiece.stamina.desc: +5 max energy per point and faster regeneration.
message.onepiece.second_fruit: Your body tears itself apart… a second Devil Fruit is fatal.
message.onepiece.already_have_fruit: You already ate a Devil Fruit.
death.attack.onepiece.fruit: %1$s was overwhelmed by Devil Fruit power
death.attack.onepiece.impact.player: %1$s was smashed into the terrain by %2$s
ability.onepiece.gomu_pistol.desc: Stretch your arm back and fire your fist up to ~22 blocks. Launches enemies and dents walls.
ability.onepiece.gomu_jet_pistol.desc: Gear Second: no wind-up, over twice as fast, hits much harder.
ability.onepiece.gomu_whip.desc: Stretched leg sweeps a wide arc, knocking enemies sideways and mowing plants.
ability.onepiece.gomu_gatling.desc: Hold: a barrage of stretching fists that keeps enemies locked in place.
ability.onepiece.gomu_jet_gatling.desc: Gear Second: a fist every tick.
ability.onepiece.gomu_rocket.desc: Grab the block you look at and slingshot yourself there, ramming enemies on the way.
ability.onepiece.gomu_bazooka.desc: Charge: double palm strike that breaks guards, launches enemies and blasts terrain.
ability.onepiece.gomu_jet_bazooka.desc: Gear Second: charges faster and hits harder.
ability.onepiece.gomu_gear_second.desc: Toggle: +35% damage and speed, Jet techniques, faster dashes. Drains energy; fatigue afterwards.
ability.onepiece.gomu_gigant_pistol.desc: Charge: inflate your arm and fire a giant fist that hits everything, tunnels through terrain and ends in a crater. You shrink afterwards.
ability.onepiece.haki_armament.desc: Toggle: coat your body in Armament. +damage, −damage taken, hits beat rubber and Logia intangibility. Arms → legs (Lv4) → whole body (Lv8).
ability.onepiece.haki_observation.desc: Toggle: sense every presence through walls, see who intends to attack you and sidestep attacks automatically (chance grows with level).
ability.onepiece.haki_emission.desc: Charge (needs Armament active): release haki inside the target. Ignores armour, shields and blocking; the force bursts out behind it.
ability.onepiece.haki_future_sight.desc: Needs Observation active: for a few seconds you see the future and evade every attack.
ability.onepiece.haki_conqueror_wave.des: Charge and release a wave of willpower: weaker beings faint, others are intimidated and flee. Cracks the ground.
ability.onepiece.haki_conqueror_infusion: Toggle (needs Armament): every hit crackles with black lightning, hits harder and lands before contact.
stat.onepiece.haki.desc: +6 max haki per point, faster regeneration, stronger and faster-trained Haki.
screen.onepiece.haki_hint: Haki trains by use: Armament by landing coated hits, Observation by dodging and sensing in combat, Conqueror's by overwhelming others.
screen.onepiece.no_fruit_hint: Devil Fruits can be found in the world. Eating one grants unique powers – and takes away the sea.
screen.onepiece.haki_desc.armament: Hardens the body into black armour. Trains by landing coated hits.
screen.onepiece.haki_desc.observation: Senses presences and intentions, reads attacks before they land. Trains by dodging and sensing in combat.
screen.onepiece.haki_desc.conqueror: The will of a king: overwhelms the weak. Only one in a few is born with it. Trains by overwhelming others.
